title: Five-transistor OTA (composed)
description: The design-pipeline 5T OTA composed from a tail mos_array and two diff_pair blocks with klt gen-compose (examples/design-pipeline). Only the nets the composer routes (N1, TAIL_NODE, VOUT) and the substrate are top-level pins; gates and unrouted terminals are floating internal nets.

rules.frozen_netlist: netlist.spice is a hand-written reference, hashed in task.json; the scorer reads it from the repo, never from an agent sandbox.
rules.reference_layout_valid: reference.gds is the recipe's output; the corpus gate re-runs klt drc (sky130 deck: clean) and klt lvs (match) on it.
rules.generator_reachable: recipe.json lists only klt gen / klt gen-compose steps; the gate re-runs it and requires a DRC-clean, LVS-matching layout.
rules.negative_controls: neg-drc.gds fails only DRC (met1 width sliver) and neg-lvs.gds fails only LVS (resized device); the gate checks each check fires alone.
rules.open_pdk: sky130A via open_pdks; no proprietary data.

arms.draw-only: five-transistor-ota is a bounded layout of a few devices with a netlist-defined target; klt draw primitives can express a legal layout of it, and the gate scores it identically.
arms.gen-only: Reachable with klt gen / gen-compose alone: recipe.json is the existence proof and uses no draw verb.
arms.gen+refine: Seeded from the gen-only result (protocol seeding decision); every refinement edit is expressible with klt draw (base_gds / erase_um) or gen-compose.
